title: Menahem pays tribute to Pul
summary: Menahem of Israel pays Pul a thousand talents of silver (2 Kings 15:19–20).
description: Menahem of Israel pays Pul a thousand talents of silver (2 Kings 15:19–20). Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 4 “Thiele’s Bad Synchronisms Classified”, row 10, p. 47; Table 1, row ~738, p. 38).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): circa 765 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 4 “Thiele’s Bad Synchronisms Classified”, row 10, p. 47; Table 1, row ~738, p. 38
chronologies.note: Crown prince Pulu (Tiglath-Pileser III) demands tribute from Menahem in the reign of Ashur-Dan III (2 Kings 15:19–20); the king records it among other tributes in 738 BC.
